Ava - Product: Draft agenda so far - lean meeting, 40 min total.

- 11:00-11:07 CEO update (Nikhil)

- 11:15-11:22 Ops/SRE: recent incident summary + remediation (Riley)

Riley SRE: For the incident summary I'll show the timeline and two small charts: error rate spike and cold-start latencies. Posting slides to the deck.

Nikhil (CEO): Ill cover strategy context and the new policy change: updated data retention defaults for hosted logs (30 days -> 90 days opt-out) and enterprise controls for 3rd party telemetry. Well include links in the follow-up doc.

Maya - Ops: Logistics: hybrid link in calendar invite (recording ON). Please add any questions to the live Qs doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands-qna. Mark your question with "live" if you want to ask during the session.

notify-bot: Reminder posted to #all-hands and calendar invites sent. :spiral_calendar_pad:

Maya - Ops: Action items: 1) Leads -> one-slide customer/pilot callouts by Tue EOD. 2) Riley -> attach incident graphs by Wed noon. 3) Product -> final deck + demo script by Wed EOD.

Jordan Sales: Will the recording and a one-page takeaways doc be posted after? Customers ask for short executive summary.

Maya - Ops: Yes  recording link + 1-pager within 24 hours.

Ava - Product: If anyone needs speaker slots or to add a 30s callout, DM me.

Nikhil (CEO): Looking forward to a tight meeting and clear next steps. Thanks everyone.

Maya - Ops: If nothing else, bump here with any urgent items for agenda. :thumbsup:
